# Overview {.unnumbered}

libtaxii is a Python library for the Trusted Automated eXchange of Indicator
Information (TAXII) 1.x specifications.

The MISP Project maintains this fork of libtaxii. The MITRE Corporation
developed the original library. See the [MISP fork](https://github.com/MISP/libtaxii)
and the [upstream repository](https://github.com/TAXIIProject/libtaxii).

Use it to create TAXII 1.0 and 1.1 messages, serialize them to XML or Python
dictionaries, and send them over HTTP or HTTPS.

- [Install libtaxii](installation.qmd) with pip or uv.
- [Get started](getting_started.qmd) with messages, schema validation, and clients.
- [Use the command-line clients](scripts.qmd) to discover services and poll collections.
- [Browse the Python API](api/modules.qmd) for signatures and examples.
